summary: First, we formed our team and organized ourselves to work together. Then, we explored the different challenges and chose the CLPS Lunar Mission Browser challenge because it was about exploring the Moon. After that, we researched the challenge to understand its purpose and the difficulties of landing at the Moon's south pole. Next, we discussed our ideas and planned an interactive game where players could choose the best landing location and time. We considered sunlight, shadows, mountains, craters, and communication with Earth. Finally, we organized our information and developed our project to make learning about space missions more interesting and interactive.
details: Our project is an interactive game where players explore the Moon's south pole and choose the best place and time to land a spacecraft. It helps people understand the challenges of space exploration and learn how sunlight and communication affect missions. Our goal is to make learning about space more interesting and show how scientists plan successful Moon landings. We used digital tools and programming concepts to represent the Moon's surface, sunlight, and communication challenges. Our project is creative because it turns a real NASA challenge into a game where players make decisions. We considered sunlight, shadows, mountains, craters, communication with Earth, and the safest landing location.
